column1: # Words Bengalis routinely type in Bengali script but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from Avro rules (or whose phonetic output is
# wrong/ambiguous). Typed in the Avro/Bengali input mode, the English
# spelling on the left resolves directly to the Bengali form on the right,
# jumping ahead of the raw transliteration.
# Format: english<TAB>bengali   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# Keep the English key lowercase. First column is matched case-insensitively.
# Derived from autodict.dct, Avro Keyboard (OmicronLab), MPL 1.1.
# roman notation to Bengali script offline. Hand-curated entries above
# keep priority; duplicates here add alternate forms only.
